scope: Admit same-revision AC1024 RASTERVARIABLES with the exact observed direct NOD owner/reactor and 0/1/3 scalar profile. Generated ASCII/Binary output is tested; physical whole-source output, source-NOD remapping and native image behavior remain unqualified.
authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 20.1 and 20.4.91 specify the version-neutral class-version BL, frame/quality/units BS fields and parent/reactor handle layout. Autodesk's RASTERVARIABLES DXF reference documents the root owner and modeled groups: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2020/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-DDCC21A4-822A-469B-9954-1E1EC4F6DF82.htm.

physical_source.provenance: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored an R2010 DXF containing one image definition and IMAGE referencing the scratch name source.png; ODA File Converter 27.1.0 converted it to AC1024. The image file was not needed for this object-graph observation, and no drawing fixtures are committed.
physical_source.independent_decoder: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 identifies NOD 0xA with ACAD_IMAGE_VARS -> 0x2F and RASTERVARIABLES 0x2F with owner role 4 -> 0xA, one reactor role 4 -> 0xA, missing XDictionary and class/frame/quality/units 0/0/1/3.
physical_source.field_span: A source-specific C++ probe uses in-tree dwgCompressor and dwgBuffer CRC routines to extract and check the decompressed NOD and RASTERVARIABLES frames. A direct bit walk separate from the typed parser checks the source type, handle, EED/reactor/xdict prefix, BL/BS scalar values ending at bit 63, no-string marker, and both role-4 handles. It then calls the local typed raster and dictionary parsers and verifies the complete NOD binding. These are in-tree page/CRC and local-parser checks, not independent page/CRC verification.
physical_source.mandatory_binding: Compile tools/probe_ac1024_rastervariables_source.cpp against the built library, then invoke `python3 tools/audit_ac1024_rastervariables_source.py verify <documented-source.dwg> <compiled-probe>`. The wrapper requires the exact recorded SHA-256 both before and after extraction; offsets are source-specific. `author` creates a fresh scratch DXF, but producer timestamps mean a newly generated DWG is not assumed byte-identical.
physical_source.whole_file_limit: The physical AC1024 source currently stops in the existing libdxfrw HEADER path with BAD_READ_HEADER before typed callbacks. No strict output was performed for that physical source, and its source NOD 0xA to output NOD binding is not proven. The separate HEADER investigation must not weaken strict output to promote this profile.

implementation: In the existing adapter graph and source-evidence gates, allow AC1024 only for a direct NOD owner, exactly one reactor to that NOD, XDictionary-missing flag 1, no retained extension/data-storage/appdata/EED carriers, and class/frame/quality/units 0/0/1/3. Continue requiring an unchanged class/source frame, one unique ACAD_IMAGE_VARS root entry, staged object, valid IDs and same-revision output. Existing AC1021 and AC1027 gates are unchanged.
generated_validation: dwg2dxf_rastervariables_ac1024_direct_nod_adapter_transport generates its own DWG with source NOD 0xC; ASCII export uses requireResolvedOwners=false and Binary export uses requireResolvedOwners=true. Readback checks owner, reactor, fields and source-frame output binding in both modes. It tests scalar changes, missing/wrong reactor, XDictionary state, duplicate root target, cross-revision output, class version and integer bounds, with destination preservation and same-adapter corrected retry. The generated source NOD mapping is not evidence for the separate physical 0xA source. Existing AC1021 and AC1027 generated selectors also pass: 4/4 focused CTests total.
limits: No native CAD image rendering, broader scalar values, nested AC1024 owner shape, missing-reactor variants, physical full-file output or physical 0xA source-to-output mapping is claimed.
